text:
vivian_finance: Quick reminder for FY cycle: procurement & finance are asking teams to certify vendor commitments and recurring spend for next fiscal year by EOD Friday. This helps finalize reserved budgets and Reserved Capacity forecasts. Please use the portal cert flow (Procure > FY Cert).
omar_prod: Is this just for vendor renewals or all active subs and POs?
vivian_finance: All active vendor commitments, active subscriptions, and POs that have recurring fees. One-off capital POs don't need cert unless they have recurring support costs.
lucy_engineering: If we have a contractor-managed subscription billed via a contractor invoice (not a vendor record), how should we report that?
vivian_finance: Put it under the owning team and tag as #contractor-subscription in the cert form. We'll follow up to decide whether to onboard vendor vs expense.
payments_bot: Reminder: cert form will attempt to pull last 12 months of spend for each vendor and show projected annualized amount. Verify numbers and edit if your expected growth differs. Missing certs will trigger an automated hold on new purchases for that team after 30 days.
omar_prod: Any penalty if we miss the certification deadline? We have a product freeze this week.
cfo_kate: No punitive action, but teams that miss the deadline will get a temporary procurement block for new recurring purchases until the cert is filed. Emergency exceptions available if you need urgent purchases. Use the portal "Emergency Purchase" with justification.
lucy_engineering: For estimated growth, should we use conservative or aggressive numbers? We bake forecasts into capacity planning.
vivian_finance: Use your expected normal run rate (best estimate). If you expect a spike (e.g., marketing campaigns), add that as a separate line item with dates. Procurement will use those to recommend dedicated capacity vs hosted options.
payments_bot: New audit rule: Finance will run a 21-day validation on cert entries and may contact listed owners for clarification.
omar_prod: One more: will this affect vendor payment timing or terms? We have a few vendors on Net-45 that asked about cashflow.
cfo_kate: No direct change to payment terms from the cert. However, certs help finance prioritize pre-pay or committed spend. If a vendor needs special terms, request it via vendor intake and note it in the cert.
lucy_engineering: Thanks, filing now. Will flag any ambiguous items as "needs procurement help".
vivian_finance: Thanks all — we'll publish a short summary of the certs and any material changes to budgets in next week's finance recap. If you need help, contact vendor-ops@redwood.com or ping me directly. :spiral_calendar:
